blocks: ## T01 - the run record says what ran, why, and where the time went (FR-002, FR-005)
## T02 - a tooling change no longer runs everything (FR-001)
## T03 - the landing waits only on what can refuse it (FR-003, FR-004)
## T05 - a landing runs what its change reaches (FR-006)

decisions.summary: runstats.py phase marks; done/test recipes mark each phase; end returns phases
LOGRUN omits plan_mode/plan_reason/selected when the gate stopped before its test phase (no plan, nothing selected)
decisions.why: Physically nothing to record: no plan was made and no tests ran, so no full run occurred and GM item 2 ('every full run') is untouched.

decisions.summary: LOGRUN omits the reason (or reads a plan.json not written by this run) for a full test run that did not go through the planner - e.g. test-full or FR-006's background refresh
decisions.why: GM item 2 says the reason for EVERY full run; FR-002 is a MUST. Recording a reason is not impossible (the target knows it is test-full / the refresh). The block's 'left out where its source is absent' is not confined to the no-test-phase case, the plan itself adds a new full run (the refresh), and a stale plan.json from an earlier run would record a wrong reason - the mechanism cannot reach its stated purpose. Fix: every run of the test phase writes this run's plan.json (planner, or the target with its own reason such as test-full / refresh) before LOGRUN reads it, and LOGRUN reads only this run's plan; absence then means only that no tests ran.

decisions.summary: gate_config_hash over ci/, pipeline/, switches.py, _invocation.py, tests/conftest.py, tests/_scope.py, pinned lockfiles, pyproject pytest/coverage tables, Makefile test/test-full recipes and referenced variables minus help comments; plan full on gate_config move, not on tooling alone; missing key counts as moved once
decisions.why: Carries FR-001 and SC-001 (test target recipe, coverage table, requirements.txt full; help line, requirements*.in incremental). Premise not verifiable from the bundle: every non-lockfile path listed is already in today's TOOLING_PATHS; if one is not, D3 adds a full trigger outside FR-001's 'of the paths the tooling hash covers' and the block must be amended.

decisions.summary: scripts moved, gate_config not: select tests/tooling and tests/hooks modules plus every module (or transitively imported tests/ helper) whose source contains substring 'scripts'; reuse_tooling; gate_full becomes gate_reuses
decisions.why: FR-001's static loose rule, and the request's parenthetical that tooling tests are reused per test on their reads; the gate_reuses change is the mechanism that reuse requires on an incremental plan.

decisions.summary: cohort-landing runs fixed seeds and pinned rows beside the gate; fresh block started detached after a successful push, one at a time under a lock; cohort_gate.check needs no fresh block on a landing record
decisions.why: FR-003 / GM item 3. 'One at a time' read as serializing (a later fresh block waits); a lock that dropped a landing's fresh block would narrow FR-003's MUST and is not ruled here.

decisions.summary: cover_changed.py runs beside make done; non-zero stops the gate's group and refuses with its lines; cheap_refusals no longer runs it
scripts/measure/gate_costs.py fits fixed + per-test cost from run records; 'incremental drift' compares a full baseline with the merged one
decisions.why: FR-007 / GM item 6; the drift count serves FR-006's refresh rule, which the GM asked for.

decisions.summary: The gate outside a landing keeps FULL_FRACTION; landings pass INCR_NO_CUTOFF=1
decisions.why: GM item 6: 'Drop the 60% cutoff from landings'.

decisions.summary: Cutoff/refresh rule deferred to T04's numbers, amended into the spec and reviewed
decisions.why: FR-007 requires the rule to wait on the measurement; decides nothing yet. When re-answered, the refresh's run record must carry its full-run reason (see D2b).

decisions.summary: SC-006's measured landing may be T05's own landing
decisions.why: T05 edits l7r/diagram/ci/, which D3 puts in gate_config, so its landing plans full by its own change and cannot exhibit FR-001 or FR-006 - the very thing measured against T26's 8.8 minutes. 'The next real landing' is word-plausible; SC-006's class ('an engine landing after a tooling change') and the purpose defeat it. Fix: the measured landing is the first whose own change does not move gate_config, whose baseline already carries the gate_config key, and which has a scripts/ change since its baseline - confirmed by plan_mode incremental in its T01 record.

decisions.summary: SC-006's measured landing may be feature 405's next task
decisions.why: An engine landing after a tooling change, as SC-006 asks - provided it meets D9a's criterion (does not move gate_config, baseline carries the key, scripts/ changed since baseline).
